title: Battle of Garisi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Garisi", at revision 1370785618, opens: "The Battle of Garisi was fought between the Georgian and Safavid Iranian armies at the village of Garisi in 1556, and resulted in a stalemate between both sides." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871082, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1556 battle between Georgian and and Iranian kingdoms". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
